title: Amendment: PreSolicitation for Coca-Cola Cans and Bottles support for DLA Troop Support to military customers in the States of Washington (WA) & Idaho (ID)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.TROOP SUPPORT SUBSISTENCE.DLA TROOP SUPPORT
detail_text: This PreSolicitation is being amended to advise the Solicitation will be posted in May of 2026. Solicitation SPE300-26-R-X011 is designed to place Canned and Bottled Soda Products, all fully competitive, contract for various Department of Defense (“DoD”) customers in the states of Washington & Idaho. The resultant contract will be issued as a firm-fixed price, Simplified Indefinite Delivery Contract (SIDC). The solicitation contains one group: Group 1 – Washington & Idaho Troops All responsible sources may submit proposals that will be considered by DLA Troop Support. Copies of the solicitation will be found on the DLA BSM internet Bid Board Systems (DIBBS) at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil . If not registered; prospective offerors will be required to do so prior to reviewing and downloading a copy of the solicitation. RFP’s are in Portable Document Format (PDF). In order to download and view these documents, prospective offerors will need the latest version of Adobe Acrobat Reader. The software is available free at http://adobe.com NO OFFERS DUE AT THIS TIME.
